name: Horizontal Hold
description: The picture loses its horizontal hold like an old TV: it shears into diagonal bands that slide sideways and wrap around, separated by a slanted blanking bar that carries the second clip in, then the shear straightens, wobbles and locks. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: slips
params.description: Number of times the picture slips sideways before it locks

params.name: shear
params.description: How far the lines lag from top to bottom at the worst of the tearing, in picture widths

params.name: bar_width
params.description: Width of the blanking bar between the copies of the picture
